The five entity families. Every one has the same shape — list, get, create, update, delete — and the same optimistic-concurrency contract on update (KAIROS-A-0004): submit the `version` you read, and a concurrent edit gets 409 with the current entity in `details.current`. A write to a claimed task by a different person gets the header `Kairos-Warning: <code> claimed by <name> since <time>` (KAIROS-T-0359). A task with open blockers can move into a claims column or a done column. That answer gets the header `Kairos-Warning: <code> moved into <column>, blocked by <blocker> (open)` (KAIROS-T-0565).

## tasks

### `GET /api/tasks`

List tasks (open tenant-wide, S-0005 list envelope).

`?include_deleted=true` widens the listing to archived work, each row
marked with `archived_at` (KAIROS-A-0020 rule 2). Default false: rule 3
is that a listing nobody asked hides put-away work.

| Parameter | In | Required | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `limit` | query | no | `integer` | Page size (default 50, max 200). |
| `offset` | query | no | `integer` | Rows to skip (default 0). |
| `include_deleted` | query | no | `boolean` | Include archived (put-away) rows, each marked with `archived_at` (KAIROS-A-0020 rule 2). Default false â rule 3 is that a listing nobody asked hides them. `total` widens with the page, never independently of it. |

| Response | Body | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `200` | [`ListEnvelope_Task`](../schemas/#listenvelope_task) | Page of tasks |
| `401` | [`ErrorEnvelope`](../schemas/#errorenvelope) | Missing/invalid token |

### `POST /api/tasks`

Create a task. `task_type` defaults to `task`.

A task starts in the entry column of its board (KAIROS-T-0566). A
`column_id` of another column gives a 422. Create the task there, then
move it. The move runs the claim, the WIP warning and the dispatch rules
of the column. The dispatch rules of the entry column fire for the
create.

A caller with `manage_tasks` on the target board can use any work class.
Every other member of the tenant sends a request (`file_backlog`,
COLLIERY-T-0218, COLLIERY-A-0023): the target is a delivery board, and
the work class is `support`.

Name the board with `board_id`, or name a team with `team_id` to use
the delivery board of that team (COLLIERY-T-0217, COLLIERY-A-0023).
`repository` is an optional link. It can be any live repository, and it
does not choose the board.

`parent` (KAIROS-T-0572) is the short code of the parent initiative.
Kairos writes the task and the edge in one transaction: a refused
parent leaves no task. The link rule applies to the edge; the creator of the
task can edit it, so it passes. In a claims column, `parent_gate`
applies (KAIROS-A-0040).

Request body (required): `application/json`, [`CreateTaskRequest`](../schemas/#createtaskrequest)

| Response | Body | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `201` | [`Task`](../schemas/#task) | Created |
| `403` | [`ErrorEnvelope`](../schemas/#errorenvelope) | Missing capability. For a caller without `manage_tasks` on the board: the work class `planned`, or a board that is not a delivery board |
| `422` | [`ErrorEnvelope`](../schemas/#errorenvelope) | No board and no team, a team that is not the team of the board, a team without exactly one delivery board, unknown board/column/repository/parent, a column that is not the entry column of the board, a parent that is not an initiative, PARENT_NOT_ACTIVE (a claims column under an inactive parent), or bad enum value |

### `GET /api/tasks/{short_code}`

Get one task by short code (open tenant-wide).

| Parameter | In | Required | Type | Description |

### `DELETE /api/tasks/{short_code}`

Archive a task (a soft delete, KAIROS-A-0001). A restore brings it
back. To delete a task for good, use `POST /api/tasks/{short_code}/purge`.

The edit rule applies (COLLIERY-T-0228). The caller created the
task, holds `manage_tasks` on its board, or is an organization admin.
Intake is a support-lane task in the entry column, and its archive is
a "won't do". Kairos refuses an agent's archive of intake with
`AGENT_TRIAGE_OFF` while the board lets a person decide
(KAIROS-T-0537).

| Parameter | In | Required | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `short_code` | path | yes | `string` | Task short code |

| Response | Body | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `200` | [`DeleteResponse`](../schemas/#deleteresponse) | Archived; notes the cascade. A restore brings the task back |
| `403` | [`ErrorEnvelope`](../schemas/#errorenvelope) | Refused by the edit rule: the caller did not create the item and lacks the capability, or AGENT_TRIAGE_OFF (an agent's archive of intake) |
| `404` | [`ErrorEnvelope`](../schemas/#errorenvelope) | Unknown short code |

### `PATCH /api/tasks/{short_code}`

Update task content (KAIROS-A-0004 optimistic concurrency).

The edit rule applies (COLLIERY-T-0228). The caller created the
task, holds `manage_tasks` on its board, or is an organization admin.

| Parameter | In | Required | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `short_code` | path | yes | `string` | Task short code |

| Response | Body | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `200` | [`Task`](../schemas/#task) | Updated (new version) |
| `403` | [`ErrorEnvelope`](../schemas/#errorenvelope) | Refused by the edit rule: the caller did not create the item and lacks the capability |

| `409` | [`ErrorEnvelope`](../schemas/#errorenvelope) | Stale version; details.current carries the current entity |

### `POST /api/tasks/{short_code}/cancel`

Cancel a task (KAIROS-T-0362): a "won't do", with a reason. The task
moves to the done column of its board, and it gets the cancel mark
with the reason. The transition rules of the board do not apply. You
can cancel a task from each column that is not done. A cancel ends the
claim of the task.

A move of the task out of the done column removes the mark. The
history keeps the reason (the activity row `cancel`).

Requires `transition_items` on the board of the task, the capability
of a move. The creator of the task gets no right here.

| Parameter | In | Required | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `short_code` | path | yes | `string` | Task short code |

Request body (required): `application/json`, [`CancelTaskRequest`](../schemas/#canceltaskrequest)

| Response | Body | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `200` | [`Task`](../schemas/#task) | Cancelled: the task is in the done column, with the mark |
| `403` | [`ErrorEnvelope`](../schemas/#errorenvelope) | Missing capability |
| `404` | [`ErrorEnvelope`](../schemas/#errorenvelope) | Unknown short code |
| `422` | [`ErrorEnvelope`](../schemas/#errorenvelope) | VALIDATION (`reason` is empty; details.field names it), TASK_DONE (the task is in a done column), or NO_DONE_COLUMN (the board has no done column) |

### `POST /api/tasks/{short_code}/claim`

Take the claim of a task in Active that has no claim (KAIROS-T-0528).
The caller must be a person. The claim names the caller, with the agent
key of the request when an agent made it (KAIROS-A-0024).

Requires `transition_items` on the board of the task (KAIROS-T-0642):
the edit rule gives no claim. No body.

| Parameter | In | Required | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `short_code` | path | yes | `string` | Task short code |

| Response | Body | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `200` | [`Task`](../schemas/#task) | The caller has the claim |
| `403` | [`ErrorEnvelope`](../schemas/#errorenvelope) | The caller does not hold transition_items on the board of the task |
| `404` | [`ErrorEnvelope`](../schemas/#errorenvelope) | Unknown short code |
| `409` | [`ErrorEnvelope`](../schemas/#errorenvelope) | CLAIMED (a different person has the claim; the details name the holder), or CONFLICT (the caller has it already) |
| `422` | [`ErrorEnvelope`](../schemas/#errorenvelope) | NOT_CLAIMABLE (the task is not in Active), or VALIDATION (the caller is a service account) |

### `POST /api/tasks/{short_code}/hand-off`

Give the claim of a task in Active to a person (KAIROS-T-0359,
KAIROS-A-0024). `to` is a user id, an email or a user name of a person
of the organization, or `me`. The task stays in Active, and the person
gets the claim. A service account cannot have a claim.

The person must hold `transition_items` on the board of the task
(KAIROS-T-0530). The team of the board gives it, and so do a grant and
the organization admin role. Else the answer is 422 VALIDATION on `to`.

The person who has the claim may hand it off. Any other caller needs
`transition_items` on the board of the task. That capability moves the
task into and out of Active. The creator of the task gets no right
here.

| Parameter | In | Required | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `short_code` | path | yes | `string` | Task short code |

Request body (required): `application/json`, [`HandOffRequest`](../schemas/#handoffrequest)

| Response | Body | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `200` | [`Task`](../schemas/#task) | The person has the claim |
| `403` | [`ErrorEnvelope`](../schemas/#errorenvelope) | The caller does not have the claim and does not have transition_items |
| `404` | [`ErrorEnvelope`](../schemas/#errorenvelope) | Unknown short code |
| `409` | [`ErrorEnvelope`](../schemas/#errorenvelope) | The person has the claim already |
| `422` | [`ErrorEnvelope`](../schemas/#errorenvelope) | NOT_CLAIMABLE (the task is not in Active), or VALIDATION (`to` is not a person of the organization, or does not hold transition_items on the board of the task) |

### `GET /api/tasks/{short_code}/hand-off-targets`

The persons who can get the claim of a task (KAIROS-T-0530). Each
person holds `transition_items` on the board of the task. The team of
the board gives it, and so do a grant and the organization admin role.
The list is in the order of the email. It has no service account.

Each member of the organization can read the list, as with the
members of a board (KAIROS-A-0006).

| Parameter | In | Required | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `short_code` | path | yes | `string` | Task short code |

| Response | Body | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `200` | array of [`HandOffTarget`](../schemas/#handofftarget) | The persons who can get the claim |
| `404` | [`ErrorEnvelope`](../schemas/#errorenvelope) | Unknown short code |

### `POST /api/tasks/{short_code}/move`

Move a task to another DELIVERY board (KAIROS-I-0012): it lands in the
target's entry column and follows the target's team. Requires
`manage_tasks` on the current board AND on the target (org admins
bypass, as everywhere). The move does not look at the repository of the
task, and the task keeps it (COLLIERY-T-0217, COLLIERY-A-0023). The
creator of the task gets no right here (COLLIERY-T-0228).

`rename: true` (COLLIERY-T-3101) also gives the task the next code of the
target board, in the same transaction. Kairos retires the old code. Each
reference to the old code in the text of the items changes to the new
code, one time. A code in a URL or a path does not change. The response
has the new code. Without `rename`, the task keeps its code.

A task in a done column (completed or cancelled) does not move: 422
`TASK_DONE` (KAIROS-T-0564). Reopen it first
(`POST /api/tasks/{short_code}/reopen`), then move it.

| Parameter | In | Required | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `short_code` | path | yes | `string` | Task short code |

Request body (required): `application/json`, [`MoveTaskRequest`](../schemas/#movetaskrequest)

| Response | Body | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `200` | [`Task`](../schemas/#task) | Moved (new board, entry column) |
| `403` | [`ErrorEnvelope`](../schemas/#errorenvelope) | Missing manage_tasks on either board |
| `404` | [`ErrorEnvelope`](../schemas/#errorenvelope) | Unknown short code or board |
| `422` | [`ErrorEnvelope`](../schemas/#errorenvelope) | SAME_BOARD | NOT_DELIVERY_BOARD | NO_ENTRY_COLUMN | RENAME_NOT_NEEDED (the code has the prefix of the target board) | TASK_DONE (the task is in a done column: reopen it first) | PARENT_NOT_ACTIVE |

### `POST /api/tasks/{short_code}/purge`

Delete an archived task for good (KAIROS-T-0362). Nothing can bring it
back. Archive the task first (`DELETE /api/tasks/{short_code}`). Kairos
refuses a live task with `TASK_LIVE` (KAIROS-T-0570).

The purge removes these rows of the task:

- the task, its history and its metadata;
- its edges and its edge proposals;
- its forge links, its external references and its embeddings;
- its retired codes and its forge intake row;
- its claim and its cancel mark.

The items at the other end of the edges stay. The activity rows about
the task stay. One new row (`purge`) names the code and the title. A
new import of the issue of an intake task makes a task again.

This is a separate route, and not a flag of `DELETE`. `DELETE`
archives. A purge must not be one query parameter away from an
archive.

Requires `purge` on the board of the task. Team membership does not
give it, and `manage_tasks` is not enough. An organization admin has
it. The creator of the task gets no right here.

Intake is a
support-lane task in the entry column. Kairos refuses an agent's purge
of intake with `AGENT_TRIAGE_OFF` while the board lets a person decide
(KAIROS-T-0537). Send the current code. The route does not follow a
retired code.

| Parameter | In | Required | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `short_code` | path | yes | `string` | Task short code (the current code) |

| Response | Body | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `200` | [`PurgeTaskResponse`](../schemas/#purgetaskresponse) | Deleted for good |
| `403` | [`ErrorEnvelope`](../schemas/#errorenvelope) | Missing purge on the board of the task, or AGENT_TRIAGE_OFF (an agent's purge of intake) |
| `404` | [`ErrorEnvelope`](../schemas/#errorenvelope) | Unknown short code |
| `422` | [`ErrorEnvelope`](../schemas/#errorenvelope) | TASK_LIVE: the task is not archived. Archive it first |

### `POST /api/tasks/{short_code}/release`

End the claim of a task in Active (KAIROS-T-0359, KAIROS-A-0024). The
task stays in Active with no claim. It is free for anyone: a claim
(`POST .../claim`) or a move to Active takes it.

The person who has the claim may release it. Any other caller needs
`transition_items` on the board of the task. No body.

| Parameter | In | Required | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `short_code` | path | yes | `string` | Task short code |

| Response | Body | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `200` | [`Task`](../schemas/#task) | The task has no claim |
| `403` | [`ErrorEnvelope`](../schemas/#errorenvelope) | The caller does not have the claim and does not have transition_items |
| `404` | [`ErrorEnvelope`](../schemas/#errorenvelope) | Unknown short code |
| `422` | [`ErrorEnvelope`](../schemas/#errorenvelope) | NOT_CLAIMABLE (the task is not in Active), or NO_CLAIM (the task has no claim) |

### `POST /api/tasks/{short_code}/reopen`

Reopen a done task (KAIROS-T-0564): a completed task or a cancelled
task. The task moves to the first column of its board that is not done,
by position. On a seeded delivery board, that column is Backlog.

The transition rules of the board do not apply. The board policy
`parent_gate` applies to that column, as for a transition. The reopen
removes the cancel mark, and the history keeps the reason. The event is
`item_transitioned`. No body.

Requires `transition_items` on the board of the task, the capability
of a move. The creator of the task gets no right here.

| Parameter | In | Required | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `short_code` | path | yes | `string` | Task short code |

| Response | Body | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `200` | [`Task`](../schemas/#task) | Reopened: the task is in the first column that is not done |
| `403` | [`ErrorEnvelope`](../schemas/#errorenvelope) | Missing capability |
| `404` | [`ErrorEnvelope`](../schemas/#errorenvelope) | Unknown short code |
| `422` | [`ErrorEnvelope`](../schemas/#errorenvelope) | TASK_NOT_DONE (the task is not in a done column), NO_OPEN_COLUMN (each column of the board is done), or PARENT_NOT_ACTIVE (the column holds claims and the initiative is not active) |

### `PUT /api/tasks/{short_code}/repository`

Set the repository a task links to, or clear it (KAIROS-T-0104).
The link can be any live repository. The board and the team of the task
do not change (COLLIERY-T-0217, COLLIERY-A-0023).

The edit rule applies (COLLIERY-T-0228). The caller created the
task, holds `manage_tasks` on its board, or is an organization admin.

| Parameter | In | Required | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `short_code` | path | yes | `string` | Task short code |

Request body (required): `application/json`, [`SetTaskRepositoryRequest`](../schemas/#settaskrepositoryrequest)

| Response | Body | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `200` | [`Task`](../schemas/#task) | Repository link updated. `null` or an empty string clears it |
| `403` | [`ErrorEnvelope`](../schemas/#errorenvelope) | Refused by the edit rule: the caller did not create the item and lacks the capability |
| `404` | [`ErrorEnvelope`](../schemas/#errorenvelope) | Unknown short code |
| `422` | [`ErrorEnvelope`](../schemas/#errorenvelope) | Unknown repository |

### `PUT /api/tasks/{short_code}/state`

Write the live state of a task (KAIROS-T-0506): branch, last commit,
pushed, PR, next step. Each task has one state. The state is not
content: no new version of the task. The edit rule applies: the
creator of the task, the holder of its claim, or `manage_tasks` on its
board.

The write is a patch (KAIROS-T-0533). A field that you send gets the
value. `null` clears the field. A field that you do not send keeps its
value. Send at least one field. `expected_updated_at` refuses a write
over a state that changed since.

A write that changes a field writes one activity row with the names of
the fields (KAIROS-T-0557).

| Parameter | In | Required | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `short_code` | path | yes | `string` | Task short code |

Request body (required): `application/json`, [`SetTaskStateRequest`](../schemas/#settaskstaterequest)

| Response | Body | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `200` | [`Task`](../schemas/#task) | The task, with its state |
| `403` | [`ErrorEnvelope`](../schemas/#errorenvelope) | Refused by the edit rule: the caller did not create the task, has no claim on it, and lacks manage_tasks |
| `404` | [`ErrorEnvelope`](../schemas/#errorenvelope) | Unknown short code, or the task is archived |
| `409` | [`ErrorEnvelope`](../schemas/#errorenvelope) | The state changed after expected_updated_at; details.state is the current state |
| `422` | [`ErrorEnvelope`](../schemas/#errorenvelope) | The body has no field, a bad expected_updated_at, or an unknown field |

### `POST /api/tasks/{short_code}/transition`

Move a task to another column (requires `transition_items` on the
task's board). The creator of the task gets no right here
(COLLIERY-T-0228).

| Parameter | In | Required | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `short_code` | path | yes | `string` | Task short code |

Request body (required): `application/json`, [`TransitionRequest`](../schemas/#transitionrequest)

| Response | Body | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `200` | [`Task`](../schemas/#task) | Transitioned (new column) |
| `403` | [`ErrorEnvelope`](../schemas/#errorenvelope) | Missing capability |
| `404` | [`ErrorEnvelope`](../schemas/#errorenvelope) | Unknown short code |
| `422` | [`ErrorEnvelope`](../schemas/#errorenvelope) | Invalid transition; details.allowed_targets lists valid moves |

### `POST /api/tasks/{short_code}/work-class`

Move a task between the Planned/Support lanes (KAIROS-T-0077;
requires `transition_items` on the task's board — lane moves are
board moves in UX terms, though the rules engine is never consulted).
The creator of the task gets no right here (COLLIERY-T-0228).

| Parameter | In | Required | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `short_code` | path | yes | `string` | Task short code |

Request body (required): `application/json`, [`SetWorkClassRequest`](../schemas/#setworkclassrequest)

| Response | Body | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `200` | [`Task`](../schemas/#task) | Lane updated |
| `403` | [`ErrorEnvelope`](../schemas/#errorenvelope) | Missing capability |
| `404` | [`ErrorEnvelope`](../schemas/#errorenvelope) | Unknown short code |
| `422` | [`ErrorEnvelope`](../schemas/#errorenvelope) | Bad work_class value |

## documents

### `GET /api/documents`

List documents (open tenant-wide, S-0005 list envelope).

`?include_deleted=true` widens the listing to archived work, each row
marked with `archived_at` (KAIROS-A-0020 rule 2). Default false: rule 3
is that a listing nobody asked hides put-away work. Note this is the
`deleted_at` sense of archived, not the editorial `lifecycle` value of
the same name (KAIROS-T-0078) — a published document can be
editorially archived and perfectly live.

`?repository=` keeps the documents that impact that repository
(COLLIERY-T-0269). The value is the slug or the id of a live
repository. An unknown repository is a 422 `VALIDATION`.

| Parameter | In | Required | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `limit` | query | no | `integer` | Page size (default 50, max 200). |
| `offset` | query | no | `integer` | Rows to skip (default 0). |
| `include_deleted` | query | no | `boolean` | Include archived (put-away) rows, each marked with `archived_at` (KAIROS-A-0020 rule 2). Default false. |
| `repository` | query | no | `string` | Only the items that impact this repository (slug or UUID of a live repository). An unknown repository is a 404 `NOT_FOUND`. |

| Response | Body | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `200` | [`ListEnvelope_Document`](../schemas/#listenvelope_document) | Page of documents |
| `401` | [`ErrorEnvelope`](../schemas/#errorenvelope) | Missing/invalid token |
| `422` | [`ErrorEnvelope`](../schemas/#errorenvelope) | Unknown repository |

### `POST /api/documents`

Create a document. It needs `board`: the board that owns the document
(COLLIERY-T-3109, see the module docs). The code of the document gets
the prefix of that board.

The caller needs `manage_documents` on that board. With
`parent_short_code`, the document also supports that item. With
`template_id`, the template's content and metadata defaults are stamped
(KAIROS-A-0003).

Request body (required): `application/json`, [`CreateDocumentRequest`](../schemas/#createdocumentrequest)

| Response | Body | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `201` | [`Document`](../schemas/#document) | Created. With parent_short_code, the supports edge is written |
| `403` | [`ErrorEnvelope`](../schemas/#errorenvelope) | Missing manage_documents on the board that the document names |
| `404` | [`ErrorEnvelope`](../schemas/#errorenvelope) | Unknown board |
| `422` | [`ErrorEnvelope`](../schemas/#errorenvelope) | No board (details.field is board), unknown parent, non-workflow parent, or unknown template |

### `GET /api/documents/{short_code}`

Get one document by short code (open tenant-wide).

| Parameter | In | Required | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `short_code` | path | yes | `string` | Document short code |

| Response | Body | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `200` | [`Document`](../schemas/#document) | The document |
| `404` | [`ErrorEnvelope`](../schemas/#errorenvelope) | Unknown short code |

### `DELETE /api/documents/{short_code}`

Soft-delete a document.

The edit rule applies (COLLIERY-T-0228). The caller created the
document, holds `manage_documents` on the board of the document, or is an organization admin.
The archive removes no `impacts` link, and the restore needs no
repair (COLLIERY-T-0269).

| Parameter | In | Required | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `short_code` | path | yes | `string` | Document short code |

| Response | Body | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `200` | [`DeleteResponse`](../schemas/#deleteresponse) | Soft-deleted; notes the cascade |
| `403` | [`ErrorEnvelope`](../schemas/#errorenvelope) | Refused by the edit rule: the caller did not create the item and lacks the capability |
| `404` | [`ErrorEnvelope`](../schemas/#errorenvelope) | Unknown short code |

### `PATCH /api/documents/{short_code}`

Update document content (KAIROS-A-0004 optimistic concurrency).

The edit rule applies (COLLIERY-T-0228). The caller created the
document, holds `manage_documents` on the board of the document, or is an organization admin.
The board of the document is its owner board (COLLIERY-T-0269).

| Parameter | In | Required | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `short_code` | path | yes | `string` | Document short code |

Request body (required): `application/json`, [`UpdateContentRequest`](../schemas/#updatecontentrequest)

| Response | Body | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `200` | [`Document`](../schemas/#document) | Updated (new version) |
| `403` | [`ErrorEnvelope`](../schemas/#errorenvelope) | Refused by the edit rule: the caller did not create the item and lacks the capability |
| `404` | [`ErrorEnvelope`](../schemas/#errorenvelope) | Unknown short code |
| `409` | [`ErrorEnvelope`](../schemas/#errorenvelope) | Stale version; details.current carries the current entity |

### `PATCH /api/documents/{short_code}/board`

Change the owner board of a document (COLLIERY-T-0269).

This is a move and not an edit. The caller needs `manage_documents` on
two boards: the board that owns the document now, and the new board.
An organization admin needs no capability. The creator of the document
gets no right to change its owner.

Each document has an owner board (COLLIERY-T-3109), and you cannot
remove it. The server refuses a null or an empty `board`: 422
`VALIDATION`, and `details.field` is `board`.

The board that the document has changes nothing: the response is 200,
and the server writes nothing. Not a content edit: no version bump and
no history row. The activity log gets one entry with the action
`update`.

`rename: true` (COLLIERY-T-3101) also gives the document the next code
of the new board. Kairos retires the old code. The references to the old
code in the text of the items change one time. The server refuses a
rename (422 `RENAME_NOT_NEEDED`) when the board does not change. It also
refuses it when the code has the prefix of the new board.

| Parameter | In | Required | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `short_code` | path | yes | `string` | Document short code |

Request body (required): `application/json`, [`SetDocumentBoardRequest`](../schemas/#setdocumentboardrequest)

| Response | Body | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `200` | [`Document`](../schemas/#document) | The document, with its owner board |
| `403` | [`ErrorEnvelope`](../schemas/#errorenvelope) | Missing manage_documents on the board that owns the document now, or on the new board |
| `404` | [`ErrorEnvelope`](../schemas/#errorenvelope) | Unknown short code, or unknown board |
| `422` | [`ErrorEnvelope`](../schemas/#errorenvelope) | VALIDATION: the body has no board, or a null or empty board (details.field is board). RENAME_NOT_NEEDED: a rename with no change of board, or to the prefix of the code |

### `PATCH /api/documents/{short_code}/lifecycle`

Set a document's editorial lifecycle (KAIROS-T-0078): a free-transition
label — draft | review | published | archived.

The edit rule applies (COLLIERY-T-0228). The caller created the
document, holds `manage_documents` on the board of the document, or is an organization admin.
The lifecycle is a label and not a column, so this write is an edit and
not a move. Not a
content edit: no version bump, no history row; activity-logged and
announced via the existing `item_updated` thin event.

| Parameter | In | Required | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `short_code` | path | yes | `string` | Document short code |

Request body (required): `application/json`, [`SetLifecycleRequest`](../schemas/#setlifecyclerequest)

| Response | Body | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `200` | [`Document`](../schemas/#document) | Lifecycle updated |
| `403` | [`ErrorEnvelope`](../schemas/#errorenvelope) | Refused by the edit rule: the caller did not create the item and lacks the capability |
| `404` | [`ErrorEnvelope`](../schemas/#errorenvelope) | Unknown short code |
| `422` | [`ErrorEnvelope`](../schemas/#errorenvelope) | Bad lifecycle value |

## adrs

### `GET /api/adrs`

List ADRs (open tenant-wide, S-0005 list envelope).

`?include_deleted=true` widens the listing to archived work, each row
marked with `archived_at` (KAIROS-A-0020 rule 2). Default false: rule 3
is that a listing nobody asked hides put-away work.

`?repository=` keeps the ADRs that impact that repository
(COLLIERY-T-0269). The value is the slug or the id of a live
repository. An unknown repository is a 422 `VALIDATION`.

| Parameter | In | Required | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `limit` | query | no | `integer` | Page size (default 50, max 200). |
| `offset` | query | no | `integer` | Rows to skip (default 0). |
| `include_deleted` | query | no | `boolean` | Include archived (put-away) rows, each marked with `archived_at` (KAIROS-A-0020 rule 2). Default false. |
| `repository` | query | no | `string` | Only the items that impact this repository (slug or UUID of a live repository). An unknown repository is a 404 `NOT_FOUND`. |

| Response | Body | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `200` | [`ListEnvelope_Adr`](../schemas/#listenvelope_adr) | Page of ADRs |
| `401` | [`ErrorEnvelope`](../schemas/#errorenvelope) | Missing/invalid token |
| `422` | [`ErrorEnvelope`](../schemas/#errorenvelope) | Unknown repository |

### `POST /api/adrs`

Create an ADR. On a board: requires `manage_adrs` on that board.
Off-board (no `board_id`): org-admin-only (A-0006 fallback).

`parent` (KAIROS-T-0591) is the short code of the item that the ADR
supports: a strategy, an initiative or a task. The ADR and its
`supports` edge are one transaction: a refused parent leaves no ADR.

Request body (required): `application/json`, [`CreateAdrRequest`](../schemas/#createadrrequest)

| Response | Body | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `201` | [`Adr`](../schemas/#adr) | Created |
| `403` | [`ErrorEnvelope`](../schemas/#errorenvelope) | Missing capability |
| `422` | [`ErrorEnvelope`](../schemas/#errorenvelope) | Unknown board/column/parent, a parent that is not a strategy, an initiative or a task, or bad date |

### `GET /api/adrs/{short_code}`

Get one ADR by short code (open tenant-wide).

| Parameter | In | Required | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `short_code` | path | yes | `string` | ADR short code |

| Response | Body | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `200` | [`Adr`](../schemas/#adr) | The ADR |
| `404` | [`ErrorEnvelope`](../schemas/#errorenvelope) | Unknown short code |

### `DELETE /api/adrs/{short_code}`

Soft-delete an ADR.

The edit rule applies (COLLIERY-T-0228). The caller created the
ADR, holds `manage_adrs` on its board, or is an organization admin.
An off-board ADR has no board: its creator or an organization admin.

| Parameter | In | Required | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `short_code` | path | yes | `string` | ADR short code |

| Response | Body | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `200` | [`DeleteResponse`](../schemas/#deleteresponse) | Soft-deleted; notes the cascade |
| `403` | [`ErrorEnvelope`](../schemas/#errorenvelope) | Refused by the edit rule: the caller did not create the item and lacks the capability |
| `404` | [`ErrorEnvelope`](../schemas/#errorenvelope) | Unknown short code |

### `PATCH /api/adrs/{short_code}`

Update ADR content (KAIROS-A-0004 optimistic concurrency).

The edit rule applies (COLLIERY-T-0228). The caller created the
ADR, holds `manage_adrs` on its board, or is an organization admin.
An off-board ADR has no board: its creator or an organization admin.

| Parameter | In | Required | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `short_code` | path | yes | `string` | ADR short code |

Request body (required): `application/json`, [`UpdateContentRequest`](../schemas/#updatecontentrequest)

| Response | Body | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `200` | [`Adr`](../schemas/#adr) | Updated (new version) |
| `403` | [`ErrorEnvelope`](../schemas/#errorenvelope) | Refused by the edit rule: the caller did not create the item and lacks the capability |
| `404` | [`ErrorEnvelope`](../schemas/#errorenvelope) | Unknown short code |
| `409` | [`ErrorEnvelope`](../schemas/#errorenvelope) | Stale version; details.current carries the current entity |

### `POST /api/adrs/{short_code}/transition`

Move an ADR to another column of its board (requires `transition_items`
on the ADR's board). The creator of the ADR gets no right here
(COLLIERY-T-0228). An off-board ADR cannot be transitioned: 422
`ITEM_NOT_ON_BOARD`.

| Parameter | In | Required | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `short_code` | path | yes | `string` | ADR short code |

Request body (required): `application/json`, [`TransitionRequest`](../schemas/#transitionrequest)

| Response | Body | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `200` | [`Adr`](../schemas/#adr) | Transitioned (new column) |
| `403` | [`ErrorEnvelope`](../schemas/#errorenvelope) | Missing capability |
| `404` | [`ErrorEnvelope`](../schemas/#errorenvelope) | Unknown short code |
| `422` | [`ErrorEnvelope`](../schemas/#errorenvelope) | Invalid transition (details.allowed_targets) or ITEM_NOT_ON_BOARD |
